_comment: The graphs inside smart-base's `L1` named subgraph, declared FROM WITHIN on the pattern of cat-harness's `library/graph.json` and `openapi/graph.json`: the `smart-base-L1` entry of `smart-base.json` names this directory, and this node names what it holds. Each entry is `subgraph: true`, a directory of the LAYER listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "smart-base-L1"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. Owner, 2026-11-13: 'L1..L3 as named subgraphs', 'Capitalize L', and 'Organize tools, skills, processes the same way' (issue #359). Declare only what exists: tools/, skills/ and processes/ are added in the commits that fill them.
name: L1

directories.description: Knowledge-graph layer L1, version 3.0, as Zod: what a WHO publication says. Its publication, section and element layout; the recommendations, remarks, key questions, outcomes, evidence, interventions and indicators it prints; and the citations a DAK uses to point at them. `l1.ts` is the layer as migrated from WHO smart-kg 3f5e477, and `l1-library.ts` is the library extension (L1's layout classes specialise the ingested library's, plus `implementation-practice`). It also holds the engine every layer uses: `ontology.ts` (the layer shape), `props.ts`, `vocab.ts`, `graph.ts` (the graph-document shape), `context.ts` and `loader.ts` (JSON-LD), `fsh.ts` and `emit.ts` (generation), `validate.ts` and `kgid.ts`, with `package.json` for `kg.yml`. `generated/` holds the ontology JSON, the document JSON Schema and the JSON-LD contexts; the FSH goes to the IG's `input/fsh/`.
